name: LiveAgent
verdict: No OAuth or review was found. Each customer's admin likely generates an API key and shares their account URL, though most details are unconfirmed (low confidence); likely 1-3 days.
needGuide: No — just collect the account URL and API key, but verify where the key lives in a test account first.

auth.detail: LiveAgent's public support examples pass an apikey parameter (query string on GET, form field on POST/DELETE). No OAuth was found, but the official developer portal could not be read (robots disallowed), so this is unconfirmed. Base URL is likely per customer (own domain).

effort.timeToProduction: 1-3 days (API-key paste); unknown if a marketplace exists

approval.gate: None found for API-key use. Any OAuth or partner program is unknown.

scopes.why: No scopes documented; the key likely inherits its owner's agent permissions.
scopes.summary: No scopes documented; likely inherits the key owner's agent permissions.

cost: Requires a LiveAgent account on a plan with API access (likely paid; 14-day trial likely)

Customer admin generates an API key in LiveAgent settings (verify UI path in the customer account)

Email LiveAgent to ask whether OAuth or a partner integration program exists

uncertain: Almost everything: API key location, header vs query use, OAuth availability, plan gating, rate limits. developer.liveagent.com was blocked by robots rules and liveagent.com/api had no auth details.
